title: Release (docs/release.md Steps 2-9, Release gate, Commit release id): a sandbox cut PR consumes fragments and lands as a merge commit; the dry run detects it, validates and bundles that exact SHA; a non-cut push is a green no-op; a wrong or missing actor, an earlier or merge-commit approval head, a non-owner marker, a non-cut or missing merged PR, missing, pending, red, cancelled, skipped or timed-out CI at the landed SHA, and a duplicate tag all refuse; a retry after green CI passes; no tag or release is written; the commit release id binding cuts and checks with profile paths

steps.name: stage
steps.run:
mkdir -p {state_dir}/a24 && cd {state_dir}/a24 && git init -q --bare origin.git && git -C origin.git fetch -q {source} HEAD:refs/heads/main 'refs/tags/v*:refs/tags/v*' && git -C origin.git symbolic-ref HEAD refs/heads/main && git -C origin.git show-ref --tags > tags.before; git clone -q origin.git rel && cd rel && git config user.name sandbox-builder && git config user.email builder@sandbox.invalid && printf -- '---
type: added
issue: 1
pr: 2
date: 2026-11-06
box-skill: none
---

A24 sandbox release entry.
' > changes/unreleased/1-a24-sandbox.md && sed -i.bak 's/^pr: TBD$/pr: 2/' changes/unreleased/*.md && rm changes/unreleased/*.bak && git add changes/unreleased && git commit -qm 'A24 sandbox fragment' && git push -q origin main && git rev-parse HEAD > ../base.head && echo "$(wc -l < ../tags.before) tags at $(cat ../base.head)"

steps.name: non-cut-push-no-op
steps.run:

### Fixed

- A24 non-cut edit."}' CHANGELOG.md > c.md && mv c.md CHANGELOG.md && : > $GITHUB_OUTPUT && : > $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY && python3 $T detect --skip-invalid || exit 1; cat $GITHUB_OUTPUT $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY; python3 $T detect 2> $A/e.txt; rc=$?; cat $A/e.txt; test $rc -eq 1 && test "$(cat $GITHUB_OUTPUT)" = ready=false && grep -qx 'Release skipped: ## \[Unreleased\] still has entries; land the cut PR first.' $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY

steps.name: commit-id-profile-contract
steps.run:
cd {state_dir}/a24 && A={state_dir}/a24 R={state_dir}/a24/rel O={state_dir}/a24/origin.git T={source}/scripts/release-trigger.py K={source}/scripts/release-check.py L={state_dir}/gh.log M=$(cat main.head 2>/dev/null) C=$(cat cut.head 2>/dev/null) && export GITHUB_REPOSITORY=campaign/sandbox-{run_id} GITHUB_SHA=$M GITHUB_OUTPUT=$A/out.txt GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY=$A/summary.txt RELEASE_OWNER=sandbox-owner GITHUB_ACTOR=sandbox-owner GITHUB_TRIGGERING_ACTOR=sandbox-owner; fg() { python3 {source}/scripts/fixtures/campaign/a24/forge.py {state_dir}/gh $GITHUB_REPOSITORY $M $C $(cat early.head) "$@"; }; mkdir -p cid/notes/next && cd cid && git init -q -b main && git config user.name sandbox-builder && git config user.email builder@sandbox.invalid && printf '# History

## [Unreleased]

## [1.0.0] - 2026-11-01

### Added

- First.
' > HISTORY.md && printf -- '---
type: fixed
---

A24 commit-id entry.
' > notes/next/a24.md && printf '[release]
changelog = "HISTORY.md"
fragments = "notes/next"
release_id = "commit"
' > release.toml && git add -A && git commit -qm seed && Z="python3 {source}/scripts/crew-config.py resolve --project $CREW_PROJECT --org-profile" && for v in tag commit sha; do sed "s/"commit"/"$v"/" release.toml > ../id-$v.toml; done && $Z ../id-tag.toml | grep -x 'release.release_id = "tag"  # org' && $Z release.toml | grep -x 'release.release_id = "commit"  # org' && ! $Z ../id-sha.toml > ../e.txt 2>&1 && grep "release.release_id: unknown value 'sha' (expected one of: tag, commit)" ../e.txt && python3 {source}/scripts/changelog-cut.py 1.1.0 --project release.toml --date 2026-11-06 && git add -A && git commit -qm 'Cut 1.1.0' && id=$(git rev-parse HEAD) && echo $id | grep -Eqx '[0-9a-f]{40}' && test "$(git show $id:HISTORY.md | grep '^## \[[0-9]' | head -1)" = '## [1.1.0] - 2026-11-06' && test -z "$(ls notes/next)" && python3 $K 1.1.0 --file HISTORY.md --fragments notes/next --notes ../cid-notes.md && grep -q 'A24 commit-id entry' ../cid-notes.md && test -z "$(git tag)" && echo "release id $id for 1.1.0, no tag"
